title: ITF — Zambia reinstated as active member nation
scope: ITF article documenting ZTA reinstatement as an active ITF member after a 12-year hiatus, 11 active venues/clubs, development planning, JTI ambitions and World Tennis Number adoption.
limitations: 2025 current-system evidence only; the 12-year hiatus is governance history, while venue/programme counts are capacity rather than player-quality measures.
